{{Quote|Defending fighters launching from the third moon. Nothing larger visible as yet.''"<br />"''Get a location on that fighter base, and detail the ''Inexorable'' to move in and destroy it.|A [[Tactical officer/Legends|tactical officer]] and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Bpfassh 3''' was the third moon in the complicated system which orbited the planet [[Bpfassh]]. It contained a starfighter base, which was presumably destroyed by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Inexorable (Imperial I-class)|''Inexorable'']] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
The moon was not named specifically in the only novel in which it appears. However, the tactical officer aboard the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] reported to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] that "... fighters [were] launching from the third moon."
